name: Doctor Boat Control Marine Intelligence V5.4
release_notes: Full Ahead own-ship speed tuned to approximately 10 knots.
Compact ship propulsion and rudder controls moved onto the chart at the lower-right.
Faster tug approach and clock-position response.
Stronger progressive PULL and PUSH effects with clearer vessel translation and rotation.
PUSH tugs reach the hull/fender contact position before applying force.
New pre-maneuver Technical Bollard Pull Assessment dashboard.
Assessment assumes 50,000 t displacement and 50 t bollard pull per selected tug in this phase.
Assessment displays windage area, underwater lateral area, wind/current loads, required BP, available BP and margin.
Desktop shortcuts now use the stable ~/.local/bin/drboat launcher.
